_note: ONE pool of 22 for the LinkedIn image: `cards` (c01–c12 → copy to <run>/card.html, render-card.mjs → post.png) and `templates` (01–10 original whiteboards → <run>/whiteboard.html, render-video.mjs → linkedin.png + Reel MP4s). Pick the single best fit across both. The Reel video always uses a `templates` entry. Byline always from config/author.json.
_templates_dir_note: Templates are bundled inside the skill folder. Resolve <SKILL_ROOT> to wherever the skill lives (typically ~/.claude/skills/databricks-pulse).

templates.vibe: Big hero number, comparison row, gradient bg
TV news broadcast, red BREAKING bar, ticker, lower-third byline
Cyan/magenta neon, Orbitron font, scanlines, sci-fi
use_when: Mosaic AI / Foundation Models / agentic stack
Anything DatabricksIQ / Genie / Agent Bricks adjacent
Long-form piece referenced as a 'paper of record' item

selection_rules: If multiple templates fit, pick the one used LEAST RECENTLY — track in state/template_history.json or check published.json. Variety beats theoretical fit.
GA launches default to 03_breaking_news but use 09_futuristic if topic is AI-agent specific.
When in doubt, the breaking_news template is the safe default — it's the only one with a battle-tested fill recipe in render-images.mjs.

cards.vibe: Huge red headline over a REAL docs screenshot with red boxes, block arrows and a callout
use_when: UI feature where the docs page has a real screenshot (deployment history, new settings dialog, trigger type)
never_when: No real screenshot available — never fake product UI

cards.vibe: 3–4 numbered pastel step columns with arrows + key-takeaways icon row
use_when: End-to-end workflow or how-to (init → develop → deploy)
Integration that moves metadata/data from A to B to C
CLI/tool launches with commands per step

cards.vibe: Bright gradient square, highlight pills, mini diagram that builds up, 3 stat tiles, release pill (GIF + PNG)
use_when: Agent/Genie/AI-BI features with a clear input → engine → output story

cards.vibe: Hero 'Is Now Generally Available!' headline, API/code panel, floating illustration cards, 4 feature items, note banner
use_when: GA milestone (or Public Preview) of an API, Terraform resource, governance or platform capability
Release with a caveat worth a note banner

cards.vibe: Red headline + 'A + B = C' concept equation with illustrated operand cards
use_when: Feature that is a combination of two existing mechanisms (row tracking + time travel = automatic CDF)

cards.vibe: 3-step 'describe → build → review' + Use it for / Skip it for panels + red stat pill
use_when: New tool/app/agent where 'when NOT to use it' matters
Beta features with clear good and bad fits

cards.vibe: Dark header 'DAILY DATABRICKS · DAY N', legacy-vs-new compare, SQL/Python code window, example result table
use_when: SQL/Python/API feature best shown in code
Behaviour change from a legacy approach
Delta, DBSQL, PySpark, system tables features

cards.vibe: Profile-header card, hand-drawn before/after architecture sketch, emoji bullet caveats, hashtag pills
use_when: Architecture simplification (a component is no longer needed)
Features with several limitations to list

cards.vibe: Dark cinematic 16:9: big uppercase hook with one highlighted word, 3-step icon flow (problem → discover → fix), SQL code window + checklist panel, red banner for the key limit, requirements footer
use_when: New SQL command or recovery/safety feature (UNDROP, restore, rollback)
Feature with one headline limit (retention window, quota) and runtime/version requirements

cards.vibe: Tall layered architecture stack: coloured layer tabs with option tiles (A OR B), down arrows, highlighted Lakehouse medallion section, consumers row
use_when: End-to-end reference architecture (ingest → transport → bronze/silver/gold → consumers)
Blog posts that explain where a feature sits in the stack
Choosing-a-path explainers (tool A OR tool B per layer)

cards.vibe: Clean white 16:9: 2–3 source cards with flowing ribbon arrows (animated particles) merging into a target card whose status flips WAITING → RUNNING (GIF + PNG)
use_when: Triggers, dependencies and orchestration (job completion triggers, cross-workspace flows)
Anything where 'when A and B finish, C starts' is the point

cards.vibe: Minimal editorial brand card: beige top with thin single-colour line-art hub-and-spoke diagram + capability box, navy bottom with big headline, mint second line, short paragraph
use_when: Platform-level / positioning messages (single control plane, governance across clouds)
Features with few hard numbers where a calm, premium look fits
Variety break after several dense infographics

card_selection_rules: Judge all 22 (cards + templates) by content shape, then rotate: never reuse the template used in either of the last 2 runs (runs/*/card.json).

Cards: GA of an API/governance capability → c04; code-first feature → c07; workflow/CLI → c02; numbers-heavy 'now supports' → c03; architecture simplification → c08; combination concept → c05; tool with fit/non-fit → c06; real screenshot available → c01. SQL recovery/safety command with a key limit → c09; reference architecture / where-it-fits → c10; triggers & orchestration → c11; platform positioning with few numbers → c12.

Whiteboards: one dominant benchmark/cost number → 02_stat_card; leader quote or strong opinion → 05_quote_card / 07_tweet_card; research/paper → 06_paper_quote; under-the-radar capability → 08_top_secret; big 'just shipped' milestone → 03_breaking_news; agentic/AI launch with little detail → 09_futuristic; step-by-step → 01_tutorial_carousel; old vs new with few details → 04_before_after; industry-shifting announcement → 10_newspaper.
Prefer a card when the item has several concrete facts (limits, formats, commands, caveats) to show; prefer a whiteboard when one number, one quote or one headline carries the post.
